environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance running PostgreSQL 14.2 with default configuration. The database role used by the application has SELECT privilege on all tables in the public schema including 'users', 'orders', 'payment_methods'. Network: application and database on same host, no intermediary. PostgreSQL pg_hba.conf allows local connections with md5 auth. No query-layer firewall or proxy between application and database.

config.db_role_privileges: SELECT on ALL TABLES in public schema
